summary: Focused frontend-only retest for iteration-4 fixes completed on public preview. Hero stacking/overflow, FAQ keyboard behavior, reduced-motion visibility, and menu Escape/X/focus-lock checks passed. Same-route mobile menu reopen flow remains flaky/inconclusive in automation after first services navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: After first open->Services navigation, subsequent toggle reopen attempts intermittently fail in automation (menu node not created/open state not reached within timeout).

action_items: Investigate mobile menu controlled state transition on /services after first navigation click, specifically reopen path after close animation lifecycle.
Add deterministic hook/assertion target for sheet open lifecycle (e.g., explicit state flag/testid) to reduce ambiguity when content is kept mounted with data-state='closed'.
Retest same-route reopen cycles after fix with captured data-state/rect/transform/animation diagnostics still enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested no-slide behavior is reflected for sheet content: .navigation-sheet uses transform:none with opacity-only keyframes (navigation-in/out).
Tablet breakpoint fix is reflected: max-width:1100 stacks hero and places .hero-photograph as position:relative at 1024px.
Sheet overlay still uses Tailwind animate-in/out utility classes; this does not reintroduce panel slide but can add timing complexity during repeated interactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed targeted checks only (no full cycle): 390px mobile menu cycles including Escape/X/rapid reopen, focus trap/return, background lock, short-height behavior; 320/768/1024/1440 overflow + hero layout; FAQ keyboard open/close; reduced-motion emulation. Diagnostics captured for failures include data-state, rect (when available), computed transform, animationName, activeElement, viewport. Failure snapshots consistently showed no mounted mobile-menu node when reopen timed out.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open homepage menu -> click Services -> attempt immediate reopen on /services; wait for [data-state='open'] can timeout intermittently. Observed diagnostics at failure: menu_exists=false, data_state=null, activeElement on mobile-menu-toggle, viewport 390x844, URL /services. Likely root area: controlled sheet open/close lifecycle race around route transition and close animation timing/state synchronization. Mitigation: instrument open state transitions and ensure post-navigation close settles before accepting next toggle-open event.
